address: Unit B20, Mae Kim Heng Market, Phoklang Road, Nai Meuang, Meuang Nakhon Ratchasima, Nakhon Ratchasima, 30000, Thailand
bio: This market stall serves khanom chin – soft, slightly chewy noodles paired with fragrant curries. Top choices include chicken red curry and Nam Ya Pradok, a coconut-based fish curry made with fingerroot and a touch of fermented fish, which is a local recipe from Ban Pradok and a true regional highlight....
